empty.title: No active Journeys yet
empty.body: Start your first Journey and it will appear here as you make progress.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.body: The Journeys you finish, and the ones you decide to stop, both rest here so you can look back on them.

empty.title: Nothing saved for later yet
empty.body: When a Journey feels right but the timing doesn't, save it here. It waits, fully planned, until you're ready for it.

capacity.review: You have {{count}} Journeys waiting here. Worth a look now and then, to see they are all still ones you want.
capacity.full: This is as many Journeys as you can keep for later at once ({{max}}). Start one, or let one go, whenever you like.

dismissConfirm.title: Remove this idea?
dismissConfirm.body: "{{title}}" will leave your Ideas for later list. You can always mention it to the coach again.
